latestVersion.changelog:
Fiverr Video Editor YouTube skill, initial release:

- Instantly edit and export YouTube videos with simple text prompts; no manual timeline needed.
- Automated connection to backend: detects or obtains API token, creates session, and manages all uploads/exports.
- Supports fast cloud-based editing (trim silences, add intros, split, text overlays) and 1080p MP4 export in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB with guided workflows (status, credits, uploads, exports).
- Provides chat-driven control, translates backend responses, and manages errors and session state seamlessly.
